title.en: What would you wish for your best friend?

text.en: If you could whisper one wish for your best friend, what would it be? This short poem by Jill Wolf is a prayer for friendship. It has only a few lines, but each line describes a quality of a good friend.

The book gives three sentences: I wish my friend brings idli in her tiffin, I hope we win the race, and may my friend get well soon. The third is closest to a prayer because it asks sincerely for someone's good. A prayer is a sincere wish for the good of someone, spoken with care and love.
The poet wishes that friendships stay the most important thing in her life. She says that with special friends she feels blessed, which means lucky and thankful. So she asks to be able to give her very best in return.
She wants to do more than share the hopes and plans of friends who care. She promises to try all that a friend can do to make their wishes come true. These lines show that she is caring and helpful. A good friend does not only listen, but also tries hard to help.
She asks to use her heart to see and understand what friends can be. She does not want to make judgements from afar, which means forming opinions without knowing someone well. She wants to love her friends as they are, with all their qualities. So the poet shows that friendship needs feelings and acceptance, not criticism.
The poem is a prayer for friendship and for friends. It says friendship should always be an important part of her life. It says friendship makes her feel special. She wishes to do her best for her friends and to make their wishes come true. She wants her heart to understand a true friend, and she prays to love friends just as they are.
Blessed means feeling lucky or grateful. Words close in meaning are grateful and thankful. A good friend can be loyal, helpful, kind, caring and honest. Loyal means always supporting you, even when you make a mistake. Honest means telling the truth. Use them in sentences: my friend is loyal to me, she is helpful, he is kind.
In pairs, act as friends. You can talk about a walk in the park by greeting, asking if your friend wishes to come, and planning activities. Or talk about sharing tiffins, appreciating the food and thanking each other. You can write a short paragraph of about eighty words on how your friendship began: when, where and how, and give it a title. Sayings such as a friend in need is a friend indeed show that a true friend stands by you in trouble.

problem.en: Complete the sentence using a word from the box: My friend is ____ to me even when I make a mistake. (loyal / honest / helpful)

text.en: Think about what the sentence says: the friend stays by you even after your mistake.

why.en: That is the meaning of staying faithful and supportive.

text.en: The best word is loyal.

problem.en: Find the line that tells us feelings are important to understand friendship.

text.en: Look at stanza 3 for the word heart.
The line is: Let me use my heart to see.

why.en: It says we understand friends with feelings, not only with eyes.

prompt.en: Explain why this poem is a prayer and what it teaches about friends.

requiredIdeas.en: The poet asks for something good for her friends and herself.
She wants to give her best and make wishes come true.
She wants to love friends as they are.

commonMisconceptions.en: It is a poem about winning a race.
It tells us to judge friends from afar.

points.en: A Friend's Prayer is a poem by Jill Wolf.
It is a prayer: a sincere wish for friends.
The poet wants to give her best, help friends' wishes come true and love them as they are.
Loyal, helpful, kind, caring and honest are qualities of a good friend.
Do not judge from afar; use your heart to understand.
